about: Unreal versions and engine forks whose root-signature rule (RootSig) a real game has confirmed, so a game on one of them needs no recording and shows no 'not tested' note. version is EngineInfo.Version; fork is EngineInfo.Fork ('GAME_...'), left out for stock Unreal; game and evidence say what confirmed it. Embedded in the app and served at /v1/content/confirmed-engines.json, the same file; the app uses the embedded entries plus the served copy's when it passes ConfirmedEngines.TryParse.
